_comment: Files behind GET /v1/companion/download/{platform}. The redirect records the hit, then 302s here. Windows has one file per CPU; x64 is the default when the site cannot tell. Mac goes to the Mac App Store listing; store 1.0.1 went live 2026-10-23 (the DMG and its appcast stay up for people who installed it). Change a file by editing this doc (scoped sync), not by deploying.
